notes: Third-pass hardening of G0369. The second-pass oracle (get_global_model_cache().get_memory_usage()) was vacuous in a clean test run because the global cache is empty — oracle=0, so abs(actual-0) <= 1.0 passed for any mutation that output '0.0 MB'. The fix seeds the real ModelCache singleton's _current_memory_bytes to exactly 256 MiB before calling _refresh_cache(), then asserts the label equals independently computed '256.0 MB'. The seeded bytes are restored in a finally block. No model loading or torch dependency is required because get_memory_usage() reads _current_memory_bytes directly under the cache lock. G0370/G0371/G0372 are unchanged from second pass.
